sections.title: Strategic Guidance for Infrastructure Success
sections.body: Navigating the intersection of high-performance computing and the Kenyan energy sector requires more than just operational staff; it requires high-level strategic oversight. Kenya AI Compute is proud to be supported by an advisory board that includes recognized leaders from the global data center industry, veterans of African infrastructure finance, and leading AI researchers from both Silicon Valley and Europe. These advisors bring a 'triple-threat' of perspective: they ensure our technical architecture is future-proof, they vet our financial structures for institutional investors, and they provide the global networking necessary to secure multi-megawatt compute contracts. Their involvement is a testament to the credibility and potential of our 1MW vision. Additional context: the project follows a clear rollout roadmap that aligns low-cost energy, infrastructure reliability, and flexible deployment models.
